Can also summon thorns on the path to damage and slow down hordes of enemies. |tooltip-2 = Capable of detecting [[flying]] and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemies. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A haunted scarecrow that fires spectral bolts and can summon thorns to slow enemies.|Inventory Description}} {{QuoteBox|A haunted scarecrow that fires piercing bolts and can summon thorns to slow enemies.|Former Inventory Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Harvester''' is a [[Towers|tower]] which fires projectiles at enemies. It could have been obtained by triumphing all [[Hexscape Event]] maps on the Hard difficulty. Most recently, it was brought back through a limited time gamepass priced at {{Robux|799}}. The '''Harvester''' deals DPS with its projectile. It has an ability to create thorns along with the path of two segments, which slow and deal damage to enemies periodically. These thorns only last for a few seconds on the path. During later levels, the '''Harvester''' gains high damage and firerate, and the thorns are enhanced to deal more damage, receive an extended lifespan, cover a larger area, and have more slowdown. The '''Harvester's''' ''Thorns'' ability also has an effect on another tower, the [[Farm]]. All [[Farm]]s in its range will create additional thorns on the path. These thorns use the same statistics as the '''Harvester''', except that the damage, duration and range statistics are halved at Level 0, with each Level increasing their power (except the range) by 10%, up to 100%. The '''Harvester''' is considerably a mid-late game tower as its main DPS can be effective during the mid-game while its ''Thorns'' ability can be great against weaker and higher health hoards later on. }} ==Skins== ''To see all the upgrades of a skin, see the [[/Gallery#Skin Upgrades|gallery]] page.'' {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:WastelandHarvesterIconIG.png|175px]] |[[File:LunarHarvesterIconIG.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|EventMission|Wasteland}} |{{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Event}} |{{Color|Legendary}} |- !Daily Store Cost |N/A |N/A |- !Obtained From |''Dark Harvest'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] |[[Lunar Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Harvester's''' high DPS allows for it to be an effective DPS for the mid to late-game. **Do note however, that it is a projectile tower with the potential of missing enemies. This can make it less reliable than towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]], which will not miss the intended target. **While not particularly great against hordes, its ''Thorns'' ability can be used to compensate for this. *The '''Harvester''' is a decent pick against mid to late-game [[Flying]] enemies, as it has flying detection from Level 0. **It does not, however, have any other detections until Level 3, where it gains the hidden detection, though its ''Thorns'' ability can be used to damage [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. ***Do note that the ''Thorns'' cannot damage either [[Flying]] or [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. *Its ''Thorns'' ability can be an effective counter against [[Aggro]] enemies. While it may not be enough to kill stronger ones, such as the [[Fallen Shield]] with [[Aggro]], it can be used to damage the crowds of enemies that appear alongside it on any part of the map. *The '''Harvester's''' ''Thorns'' ability also affects the [[Farm]] through ''Nature's Bond''. It will make all [[Farm]]s in the range of the '''Harvester''' create thorns, with their statistics being half of the '''Harvester's''' thorns statistics at Level 0, becoming stronger with Levels. **Placing down [[Farm]]s where their range covers the path while also being in the '''Harvester's''' range can significantly increase how much damage its ''Thorns'' ability deals. **The [[Farm]] can also be used to generate cash to help afford the '''Harvester's''' high upgrade costs. **[[Range Buff]]s from towers like the [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at allowing the '''Harvester''' to have more [[Farm]]s in its range and to boost their damage. *Towers that apply the [[Damage Buff]], such as the [[DJ Booth]] or [[Mercenary Base]] can be quite useful with the '''Harvester''', as they can not only boost its main attack but also the damage of its ''Thorns''. **However, do note that the [[Farm]]s are only affected if the [[Farm]] itself is in the range of the [[Damage Buff]] giver. ==Trivia== *The '''Harvester''' is the first tower to be left-handed by default, the second being the [[Assassin]]. **All other towers are either right handed or use both of their hands from Level 0. *During [[Containment]], if Hard difficulty is selected, the '''Harvester''' is included in all loadouts as a sixth tower slot, even if the player had not obtained the '''Harvester'''. ==Update
